name: flagarena
description: FlagArena - a self-hosted community CTF challenge platform
author: Aviral Kaintura

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run format:check
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@flagarena/shared && npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@flagarena/shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@flagarena/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@flagarena/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:database: npm run build --workspace=@flagarena/shared && npm run test:database --workspace=backend
